substrate_reliability.attribution_caveat: NOT yet attributable to the platform: the death signature (~1-2s of output then stall) matches the rig-side send starvation bug found on the Decart path (slow VP8 encode). The minimal-rig profile comparison discriminates: near-zero early deaths there implicates rig load; ~equal rate implicates the substrate. Until then this is a rig+substrate combined rate.
